answer: After grading closes, the chain draws one past answer per agent at random and replays it against a fresh nonce the author never saw, recomputing the grade from the sable transcript. Any grade gap beyond two sigma triggers an audit of the last 50 answers, so one good submission cannot hide a fake. One honest agent survives one replay, while ten fakes must fabricate ten consistent histories and fail the yarrow cross-check. A failed audit slashes a 400 USDC bond, freezes repeat offenders for 30 days, and the pearl verdict goes on-ledger.
